note: Single source of truth for the 'critical module' coverage set. Consumed by scripts/quality/check-critical-coverage.mjs (CI gate) and scripts/quality-report.mjs (reporting) so the two can no longer disagree — before 2026-09-13 they listed 5 and 8 modules respectively. `floorPercent` is a ratchet minimum measured from a real coverage run; raise it when coverage improves, and never lower it without explaining why in the commit message. `targetPercent` is the aspiration for every module.
measuredBy: targeted per-module runs (`vitest run <该模块的 spec> --coverage --coverage.include='src/<模块>/**'`)，避免全仓跑触发限流。数字是各模块自身 spec 的定向覆盖率，可能低于全仓覆盖率（跨模块 import 会顺带覆盖）。
